resolution.note: verify unions classic protection and ruleset required checks; KRN verify exit 0 on live gh

title: adopt --verify reads required checks from repository rulesets
body:
Why: krn adopt --verify (t-atagtp3 fe16631) reported "branch main has no single required status check from GitHub Actions" on krn-works/krn, whose ruleset requires Check from App 15368: verify reads only classic branch protection.
Outcome: verify reads required checks from both branch protection and the active branch rules (gh api repos/<repo>/rules/branches/<branch>).
Proof: test on a verbatim capture of the krn-works/krn rules answer; bin/krn adopt . --verify exits 0 on KRN.
